title: rConfig Core 8.1.0 before 8.2.20 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a missing authorization vulnerability in…
description: rConfig Core versions before 8.2.20 and rConfig Pro versions before 8.4.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in ExportController.php. This flaw allows authenticated users to bypass restrictions and export sensitive data from restricted tables, including decrypted passwords, device credentials, and API tokens.
